title: 第13章  秦王子婴第14章 大方师邹云求追读
slug: 方士开局我给秦始皇画大饼
content_zh:
就在丹墀上群情激越之际，兴乐宫深处某个幽僻拐角，一声无奈的低叹在此处响起！
‘话说，这堵墙，是不是见过好几次了！’
再一次踱步至这该死的转角，邹云盯着自己先前留下的那道刻印，嘴角忍不住抽了抽。
兜兜转转，他又回到这个起点。
很显然，这位刚刚才在众人面前，装了一手洒脱不羁的高人隐士，此刻竟在这犄角旮旯里迷路了。
“有没有人来救救我啊！”邹云气得仰头高喊。
总之，现在他不但找不到返回丹墀的方向，甚至见不到半个人影。
廊柱在午后的阳光下投出长长阴影，偌大的宫殿群，仿佛只剩下他一个活物。
四周静得骇然。
更令他烦扰的是，肚中传来阵阵饥饿感，并时不时发出咕噜咕噜的声音，搅得邹云愈发烦躁。
他索性放弃无谓的兜转，蹲在波光粼粼的湖畔，目光呆滞投向水中游鱼。
鱼儿们甩动着灵巧尾鳍，在清澈水草间穿梭嬉戏，细密的鳞片在碎金阳光下闪烁点点银光。
它们越是悠闲快活，就越衬得邹云腹中空空，那咕噜声似乎也更响亮了几分。
邹云舔了舔有些干裂的嘴唇，目光盯着一条看起来格外肥美的鱼儿，思索要如何整上一条解馋。
却又因为手无寸铁，而泛起淡淡忧伤时。
突然！
一个清脆声音在他身后猛地响起。
“喂，这里不让屙屎！”
邹云愕然回头，循声望去，只见一个身着深色锦袍，年纪约莫七八岁出头的小屁孩，正从远处一路小跑过来。
那孩子绷着一张小脸，神情严肃得有些滑稽。

正目光如炬，紧紧锁定蹲在湖边的邹云，显然是将他当作什么宵小之徒。
“此乃陛下宫禁重地，岂容你放肆！”
小男孩气喘吁吁跑到近前，努力挺直小小的身板，双手叉腰，试图让自己看起来威仪一些。
只是因为刚才那段小跑，让他胸膛剧烈起伏，小脸也泛起红晕。
全无半点威风可言，反倒显得可爱至极。
只是那小屁孩并不觉得，略为平复后，他便模仿着大人训斥的模样，用尚显稚嫩的嗓音喝道。
“尔就不惧被拖出去砍了脑袋吗？”
尽管他努力挤出最具威胁性的表情，但那副唇红齿白的清秀模样，落在邹云眼中，只透着一股强装老成的可爱劲儿。
就像只炸毛的小猫。
邹云站起身，慢条斯理地掸了掸祭服上沾染的灰尘，心中玩心顿起，刻意拉长语调反问道。
“呵，那又如何？你可知晓我是何人？”
他微微扬起下巴，让身上那套华贵非凡的祭服，在阳光下流转出温润光泽，试图以衣冠压人。
谁料，那孩子非但未被这身华贵服袍所慑，反而将他从头到脚仔仔细细打量了一番，满脸鄙夷道。
“我自然不知你姓甚名谁！”
“但我曾经听人说过，使人高尚的，从来不是华贵服饰，而是那宝贵的品德。”
“而且，能在此宫禁重地，做出......做出这等不堪行径。”
他顿了顿，似乎觉得原词不雅，终究还是换了个含蓄点的用词。
“料想，你也不是什么了不得的人物。”
少年轻轻哼了一声，语气中的不屑愈发浓烈。
见这小屁孩，一本正经的教训起自己。邹云非但不恼，反倒被勾起了浓厚兴趣，忍不住想要逗逗这小孩。

他故意板起脸，一只手猛地伸向衣带处，作势就要解开，同时刻意拔高声调挑衅道。
content_en:
Just when people on Danchi were agitated, in a secluded corner deep in Xingle Palace, a helpless sigh sounded here!
‘By the way, have you seen this wall several times? ’
Walking around the damn corner again, Zou Yun stared at the mark he had left before, and couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
Going round and round, he returned to the starting point.
Obviously, this hermit, who had just pretended to be free and uninhibited in front of everyone, was now lost in this nook and cranny.
"Is there anyone here to save me?" Zou Yun shouted in anger.
In short, now not only can he not find the direction back to Danqi, he can't even see half a person.
The pillars cast long shadows in the afternoon sun, and it was as if he was the only living thing left in the huge palace complex.
The surroundings were shockingly quiet.
What bothered him even more was the feeling of hunger coming from his stomach, which also made gurgling sounds from time to time, making Zou Yun even more irritable.
He simply gave up the unnecessary circling and squatted by the sparkling lake, staring blankly at the fish swimming in the water.
The fish flicked their dexterous tail fins and played among the clear water plants. Their fine scales shone with silver light in the golden sunlight.
The more leisurely and happy they are, the more empty Zou Yun's belly is, and the gurgling sound seems to be a little louder.
Zou Yun licked his chapped lips and stared at a fish that looked particularly plump, thinking about how to fill it up to satisfy his craving.
But when he felt a little sad because he was defenseless.
Sudden!
A crisp voice suddenly sounded behind him.
"Hey, no poop allowed here!"
Zou Yun turned around in astonishment and followed the sound, only to see a kid in a dark brocade robe, about seven or eight years old, trotting over from a distance.
The child had a sullen little face and a funny serious expression.
His eyes were fixed on Zou Yun who was squatting by the lake. He obviously regarded him as some kind of gangster.
"This is an important place in His Majesty's palace, how can you be allowed to be so presumptuous!"
The little boy panted and ran forward, trying to straighten his small body and put his hands on his hips, trying to look more majestic.
Just because of the trot just now, his chest heaved violently and his face turned red.
There is no dignity at all, but she looks extremely cute.
But the little kid didn't feel it. After he calmed down a little, he imitated an adult's scolding and shouted in a childish voice.
"Aren't you afraid of being dragged out and beheaded?"
Although he tried his best to put on the most threatening expression, his delicate appearance with red lips and white teeth only showed a cuteness in Zou Yun's eyes that was pretending to be mature.
Like a kitten with fried fur.
Zou Yun stood up and slowly dusted off the dust on his sacrificial clothes. His heart suddenly became playful and he asked in a deliberately longer tone.
"Oh, so what? Do you know who I am?"
He raised his chin slightly, letting the extravagant and luxurious sacrificial robes on his body shed a warm luster in the sunlight, trying to overwhelm others with his clothes.
Unexpectedly, instead of being intimidated by this luxurious robe, the child looked at him carefully from head to toe, with a look of disdain on his face.
"Of course I don't know your last name!"
"But I once heard someone say that what makes a person noble is never the luxurious clothes, but the precious character."
"Moreover, to be able to do... such a heinous act in this forbidden place of the palace."
He paused, as if he thought the original word was indecent, so he finally changed it to a more subtle word.
"As expected, you are not a great person."
The young man snorted softly, the disdain in his tone getting stronger.
Seeing this little brat, he taught himself a serious lesson. Instead of being annoyed, Zou Yun was intrigued and couldn't help but want to tease the child.
He deliberately made a serious face, and stretched out one hand to the belt, pretending to untie it, and at the same time deliberately pulled it out.He shouted provocatively in a high tone.
